あらすじ

Protagonist Mana is visiting a rich friend’s house for the summer. However, there are a few problems: first of all, her little sister Kurumi comes along and she doesn’t get along with the rich friend Kyouka; secondly, both Kurumi and Kyouka are insane and more than willing to murder her.
